d: Long, flowing deep forest green hair with straight bangs and a side-parted fringe frames a youthful, adolescent face with sharp, golden-amber eyes and a calm expression. The slender build is dressed in a white collared shirt with a red ribbon tie, a dark charcoal pleated mini-skirt, a brown open cardigan, black knee-high socks, and brown loafers. A pair of thin-rimmed glasses rests on the bridge of the nose. The figure holds a massive, jagged black and red sword featuring organic, tooth-like white protrusions along the edge and red orb-like accents near the hilt.
